## Documented role

[SCI BC’s history page](../sources/sci-bc-history.qmd) states that in 1960 Doug Mowat “accepts the role of Executive Director” of the BC Paraplegic Association, and that he chaired the provincial International Year of the Disabled committee in 1981.

The [Legislative Assembly’s Mowat Entrance page](../sources/leg-bc-mowat-entrance.qmd) states that he was “the first MLA to use a wheelchair while in office” and that he spent years working with the B.C. Paraplegic Foundation and the B.C. Paraplegic Association.

Later writers connect him to the 1985 Creekview / Creekside housing project ([Fayerman 2018](../sources/fayerman-2018-walt-lawrence.qmd); [SCI BC 2019](../sources/sci-bc-2019-walt-lawrence.qmd)). Those are later attributions, not 1980s ministry or CPA files.

This archive has not found a public source inspected here that names Mowat as a CSIL program designer.
